title: PAY WITH TIME
description:
1. Game IntroductionA world where money has disappeared, and time has become the only currency.

You become the owner of a shop that trades in time, serving customers and growing your business.

Use ability cards to improve your operational efficiency, and sometimes take a risk at the casino by betting your time for a chance at greater opportunities.

2. Game Features■ A Unique World Where Time Is Used as CurrencyInstead of money, time is the standard for every transaction.
Whether you are buying items, using facilities, or gambling at the casino, everything is paid for with time.

■ Shop ManagementProcess customer orders, sell a variety of products, and grow your shop.

■ Ability Card SystemEach ability card can significantly change the way you play.
Discover new strategies and create a more efficient way to run your business.

■ CasinoBet your own time in various games, including Texas Hold’em.
You may win great rewards, or lose all of your time.

■ ProgressionCollect time to unlock new facilities, upgrade ability cards, and operate an even larger shop.
description_short: Run a shop where time is the world's currency. Serve customers, earn time, and expand your business by collecting and upgrading powerful ability cards. Take risks in the casino by wagering your time for a chance to earn even greater rewards in this business simulation game.
